plan.summary: Plan to deploy a five-page static website hosted on a private S3 bucket with CloudFront distribution secured by an ACM HTTPS certificate in us-east-1. The deployment includes CloudFront Origin Access Control to restrict S3 bucket access, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection, and Route 53 DNS configuration for the custom domain csce412rahul021005.me. Human approval is required before each infrastructure change.

steps.action: Create a private S3 bucket to store the website files
steps.expected_result: A private S3 bucket is created with no public access and proper bucket policies to restrict access only to CloudFront via Origin Access Control

steps.action: Upload the five website pages (index.html, about.html, projects.html, skills.html, contact.html) and 404.html to the private S3 bucket
steps.expected_result: All website files are uploaded successfully and stored securely in the private S3 bucket

steps.action: Configure CloudFront Origin Access Control (OAC) to securely access the private S3 bucket
steps.expected_result: CloudFront Origin Access Control is created and linked to the S3 bucket to allow CloudFront to fetch content securely without exposing the bucket publicly

steps.action: Create a CloudFront distribution with the private S3 bucket as origin using the configured Origin Access Control, enable HTTPS, and set default root object
steps.expected_result: CloudFront distribution is created to serve the website content securely over HTTPS with the private S3 bucket as origin

steps.action: Configure HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection behavior in the CloudFront distribution
steps.expected_result: All HTTP requests to the CloudFront distribution are automatically redirected to HTTPS, ensuring secure connections

steps.action: Request an ACM SSL/TLS certificate in the us-east-1 region for the domain csce412rahul021005.me and any necessary subdomains
steps.expected_result: ACM certificate request is submitted successfully and pending validation

steps.action: Validate the ACM certificate by creating the required DNS validation records in the Route 53 hosted zone for csce412rahul021005.me
steps.expected_result: DNS validation records are created in Route 53, enabling ACM to validate and issue the certificate

steps.action: Configure Route 53 DNS records to point the domain csce412rahul021005.me to the CloudFront distribution
steps.expected_result: DNS records are created or updated so that the domain resolves to the CloudFront distribution endpoint

risks: Ensuring the S3 bucket remains private while allowing CloudFront access requires precise bucket policy and Origin Access Control configuration.
Implementing HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection solely via CloudFront behaviors may be limited and requires careful configuration to avoid redirect loops or unsecured access.
ACM certificate validation depends on timely and correct DNS record creation in Route 53; delays or misconfiguration can delay deployment.
Misconfiguration of Route 53 DNS records can lead to domain resolution failures or downtime.
Human approval delays may impact deployment timelines.
